reasons: Rule kind is 'missing' and the record supports it: the excerpted General Provisions (10.8 Headings; Counterparts, the last numbered subsection) contain no insurance covenant, and the rationale documents that no 'insurance' text appears elsewhere.

The inserted 10.9 tracks the playbook model language at the preferred limits (CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, cyber USD 5M, workers' comp as required by law, certificates on request) and is properly tailored to the counterparty name (HDI) and the Agreement's own data terms (Content, user information, Company Confidential Information).
Placement is correct and minimal: a new subsection appended to the end of Section 10 General Provisions, with the existing p0070 text left untouched — no collateral rewriting.

The comment is concise, first-person plural, prefixed correctly, accurately explains the insertion and the factual basis (HDI hosts the Site and handles Company data), and offers the E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M fallback as a negotiation position.
Deterministic checks confirm the operation applies and an insurance obligation is now present; no over-flagging risk since there is no existing clause sitting at the fallback.
